findings.observed: Only QUESTION_BANK.de contributes stem/options/key to the hash. Independently changing the selected English Mamma question's stem in memory leaves the version unchanged. A meaningful EN/FA translation/key correction can therefore reuse prior answers despite changed assessment content.
findings.requiredCorrection: Hash canonical DE/EN/FA content together (or an equivalent reviewed semantic content version), so language switches stay stable while substantive corrections to any selected locale invalidate the affected selection. Add EN-only and FA-only regression checks plus unrelated-topic checks.
findings.retest: Independent cycle1 read-only retest: actual new helper, committed baseline capture script, quiz key consumer, canonical identity helper and curriculum fallback read. Bundled regression and independent probes passed; details in repairRetest.

findings.observed: The new hash is an extra part of every existing v2 storage key. Every pre-change quiz key consequently differs, including wholly unmodified topics. Current tests show unrelated revisions preserve a new-style hash, not that unaffected legacy sessions survive first rollout.
findings.requiredCorrection: Either safely preserve/migrate unaffected legacy sessions, including their original option-shuffle seed, or explicitly report the one-time universal saved-session reset as a limitation and remove claims that only affected old sessions reset. Do not copy old displayed option answers under a new shuffle seed without preserving their meaning.
findings.retest: Independent cycle1 read-only retest: actual new helper, committed baseline capture script, quiz key consumer, canonical identity helper and curriculum fallback read. Bundled regression and independent probes passed; details in repairRetest.

findings.observed: canonicalQuestionId matches /-(de|en|fa)-/ only inside IDs. Existing MSK bank IDs end in -de/-en/-fa. Explicit retry/profile fragen values with a trailing locale are not canonicalized; after language switching getQuestionsForIds can drop them. The nearby bank lookup correctly supports end-of-ID tokens, so the two normalizers disagree.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use the same locale-token boundary rule for both inside and trailing tokens, and test explicit IDs such as rk-fettkissen-1-en across all three languages without losing order or answers.
findings.retest: Independent cycle1 read-only retest: actual new helper, committed baseline capture script, quiz key consumer, canonical identity helper and curriculum fallback read. Bundled regression and independent probes passed; details in repairRetest.

findings.observed: New reviewed card topics aq-pvl and aq-balkenagenesie resolve to no lesson when opened directly from the flashcard index. The new registry knows their routes, but lesson lookup searches only CURRICULUM. Lesson-origin links work because they carry from; direct card-page Study lesson shortcuts are absent.
findings.requiredCorrection: Extend direct topic-to-lesson lookup with the reviewed lightweight route registry or equivalent explicit mapping, preserving existing curriculum links and language/query behavior.
findings.retest: Independent cycle1 read-only retest: actual new helper, committed baseline capture script, quiz key consumer, canonical identity helper and curriculum fallback read. Bundled regression and independent probes passed; details in repairRetest.

positiveChecks: Current published snapshot contains only explicitly allowed supplemental IDs in every locale; draft HSV/Perthes additions do not leak.
The runtime index imports the reviewed JSON snapshot rather than authoring modules; author files can hold later pending packets without direct runtime bank exposure.
Return links use the currently selected practice language and preserve lesson query/hash; no subscription/access check was removed in the inspected paths.
Quiz still caps free-account counts through hasFullAccess/FREE_ITEM_LIMIT; flashcard page retains existing access logic.
Goal-mapped route registry derives question counts from actual registered pools rather than fabricated quotas, and preserves existing custom topic selections.
Translation lookup already supports locale tokens at the end of IDs; the remaining mismatch is specifically the quiz canonicalizer.
Existing version test restores all in-memory test mutations; independent probe likewise restores its selected question.
